spec.scope: 400 INT4 linear tensors = group 'INT4-linear' of analysis/salted/inventory.json, all under model.language_model.layers.* (48 linear-attn layers x6 projections + 16 full-attn layers x7 projections)
spec.grouping: groups of 128 columns along the input (in_features) dim, same grouping as the serving checkpoint (per-group scale, group size 128)
spec.spread: max(group_absmax)/median(group_absmax) over the per-group (128-col) absmax table: one absmax per group over ALL rows - the value the per-group quantizer scale is derived from
spec.spread_per_row: same ratio over the per-row group absmax table (r x g entries); the metric the prior-round rotation_sim benchmark reported (L63 down_proj unrotated: 14.52x) - kept for comparability

selection.rule: mandatory anchors L0/L27/L63 + top 5 remaining layers by layer-max group-128 spread; diversity cap 3 fill slots per projection family (mlp = gate/up/down; attn = q/k/v/o and in_proj_qkv/in_proj_z/out_proj)
